The implementation adds special-case bulk pricing logic that contradicts the docstring. The docstring clearly specifies "every unit is charged at the price of the tier that its own position falls in" (graduated pricing), but the code applies bulk pricing when quantity exceeds the last bounded tier. This test-specific logic exists only to make `test_bulk_order` pass.

Before merging, this needs resolution:
1. **Option A:** Update the docstring to document the bulk pricing behavior when quantity exceeds the last bounded tier
2. **Option B:** If graduated pricing is the intended spec, the test expectations need review and possible correction

The fix to the off-by-one error (`(top - first + 1)`) and the negative quantity validation are correct and should be preserved. However, the bulk pricing special case (lines checking `quantity > last_bounded_tier_last`) should not be merged without either updating the docstring or confirming with the team that the spec has changed from what the docstring describes.
